note: Gold answers and accept_patterns are for grading only. build_prompt() sends the reader the rewritten prose and the question text, nothing else.

questions.question: What does each permutation draw randomize?
questions.gold: The orientation of the labels: each training situation independently keeps or reverses all of its labels.

questions.question: What does the null hold fixed rather than randomize?
questions.gold: The rows themselves, the grouping into situations, and the label composition within each situation.

questions.question: Were the probes refit on every permutation draw, or fitted once and reused?
questions.gold: Refit from scratch on every draw, and the select split refits its own standardization constants too.

questions.question: On which data is the checkerboard interaction recomputed for each draw?
Is the reported p-value one-sided or two-sided?
Which result sits at the permutation resolution floor?
questions.gold: Gemma's logistic result, at 1/201. The Llama values at 200 draws were also at the floor before the re-run, but Gemma's support/opposition direction is not.

questions.question: Is Gemma's support/opposition direction p-value a measured value or a floor?
questions.gold: Measured: 2 draws reached the observed value, giving 0.0149.

questions.question: What p-value does the Llama support/opposition direction have after the re-run, and what did it replace?
questions.gold: 0.0132 with 131 draws at or above the observed value, replacing 0.005 which was the resolution floor.

questions.question: Why was Gemma not re-run at a larger number of draws?
questions.gold: Its layer-27 activations were not retained.

questions.question: Which row of panels carries the sharper evidence, and why?
questions.gold: The logistic activation probe, because its null is much less dispersed (SD 0.46 against 1.01).

questions.question: Does the passage explain why the two nulls differ in dispersion?
questions.gold: No. It says the experiment does not isolate why; regularization is one plausible contributor but is not separated from other differences.
